alisa: Kicked off a quick A100 vs H100 pass focusing on mixed prompt-length workloads + microburst concurrency (cold vs warm KV). Wanted to share initial numbers and ask for kernel/quantization sanity checks.
ben_ml: Nice — quick summary? numbers and configs pls.
santiago: TL;DR: H100 wins tail latency for short-prefill workloads, A100 slightly cheaper for sustained batched decode on 7B quant int8. Full notes below. :chart_with_upwards_trend: 
ci-bot: perf-run finished: job=multiworkload-h100-a100-7b sweep=microburst-2026-03-19 link=https://ci.internal/runs/1935007890
katie_research: Paste of important rows from the CSV (aggregated):
```
model,hw,prefill_ms,decode_ms,median_tok_s,95p_tok_s,cost_per_1M_tokens_usd,notes
mistral-7b,a100,28,120,3000,1800,8.9,sustained batch=32
mistral-7b,h100,22,100,3600,2300,9.6,lower tail latency
llama2-7b,a100,35,130,2700,1600,7.4,int8 stable
llama2-7b,h100,27,110,3300,2100,8.1,hot-kv benefit
```
(above cost calc used instance-hour pricing + util factor; not retail pricing)
ben_ml: Interesting that H100 shows higher tokens/sec but higher $/1M — likely because we're running smaller instance types on Hopper tests and leaving some GPUs underutilized during burst tests? need allocation breakdown.
santiago: Exactly. Two things: 1) our H100 runs were single gpu small-sku with higher per-GPU hourly; 2) kernel selection on H100 defaulted to cutlass-fused-attn for decode which improved latency but didn't fully saturate FP16 tensor cores on long decodes.
alisa: Did you try explicit kernel override? i.e., force cuBLAS/cutlass variants or enable fused KV caching?
santiago: Ran a quick sweep: `--kernel=cutlass_fused,cutlass,cuBLAS` — results: cutlass_fused best for <64 token decodes (prefill+short decode), plain cutlass slightly better for long decodes >512 tokens. cuBLAS had highest throughput when using sequence parallelism + large batch.
katie_research: Also saw quant effect: int8-llm gives ~1.2x tokens/sec uplift on A100 with negligible quality loss on our eval prompts, H100 int8 gives ~1.3x but needs per-layer calibration; int4 reduced memory but increased decode instability on a few LLM evals.
ops-bot: Note: us-west2 (h100) runs had 6% higher latency than h100 in europe (eu-central) due to cooling throttling incident on the test rack (logged). See incident 2026-03-18-rt-thermal.
ben_ml: That explains the weird eu vs us numbers. For cost calc, we included cross-zone egress overhead for multi-region clients?
santiago: We ran both local-only and cross-region fallback tests. Cross-region adds ~12ms median and ~0.9 USD per 1M tokens in our pricing model for the routes that fall back to cheaper region.
alisa: From an ops perspective, what's the recommendation for Dedicated customers choosing between A100 and H100?
katie_research: Short version: If your workload is microbursty with lots of short-turnaround chat messages (prefill-heavy), H100 gives better tail-latency and token/s for small batches — good for low-latency SLAs. If you have long streaming decodes or want best $/1M for sustained throughput, A100 with larger batching and sequence parallelism is still competitive.
ben_ml: Action items: 1) santiago/katie to add kernel override matrix to the repo with recommended kernels per prompt-length profile, 2) ops to re-run H100 tests on alternative SKU to normalize hourly cost, 3) run int8 calibration pass for H100 model variants.
santiago: I'll add the kernel matrix as a markdown in the perf folder. Example snippet I'll include: 
```
# recommended kernels
short-prefill: cutlass_fused
short-decode: cutlass_fused
long-decode (>512): cutlass
sustained-large-batch: cuBLAS + seq-parallel
```
katie_research: Also adding eval diffs for int8 vs fp16 to detect subtle regressions. Will post ROC curves and a handful of failure cases.
alisa: Great. If folks agree, we'll fold these into the onboarding checklist for new model bring-ups so infra picks the right defaults per workload. :white_check_mark:
ben_ml: Agree. One more ask: can we add a microburst synthetic test to the perf harness that uses a 90/10 short/long prompt mix and measures 99p latency? That'll help us set SLOs.
ops-bot: Added ticket PERF-712 to backlog.
santiago: Thanks team — I'll ping when kernel matrix + fresh H100-normalized cost run is done.
